themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of autonomous action and decision-making within research contexts, including their development, application, and potential risks.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, as well as their impact on the development workflow.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that aid in product development, including opportunity solution trees, synthesis, evaluation, and continuous learning loops.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discusses various AI-powered tools and platforms used for conducting research, including comparisons and evaluations of their effectiveness.

themes.name: AI-assisted content generation
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to create various forms of content, from marketing emails to illustrations and videos, and the impact on creative workflows.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Covers AI techniques and tools for analyzing large datasets, extracting insights, and identifying patterns, including specific algorithms and their applications.

themes.name: AI-driven UX benchmarks
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in analyzing and generating benchmarks for user experience, including performance scores and best practice examples.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Examines the creation and use of artificial users or survey stand-ins in research, and their accuracy compared to real users.

themes.name: Sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Details the use of AI for analyzing user sentiment and feedback from various sources, including social media and direct communication channels.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Addresses the ethical considerations and responsibilities associated with AI in research, including data privacy, accountability, and potential misuse.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
